headline: President Clinton set up an emergency board to look into a labor dispute between the Soo Line Railroad and some of its union workers.
what_it_does: This order creates a special emergency board to investigate a dispute between the Soo Line Railroad Company and certain employees represented by the United Transportation Union. Boards like this are normally set up under federal railroad labor law to study a dispute and report back to the President. The title does not give details about the dispute or the board's findings.

who_it_affects.how: The company's dispute with some of its workers is placed under review by a federal emergency board.

who_it_affects.group: Soo Line railroad workers represented by the United Transportation Union
who_it_affects.how: Their dispute with the railroad is investigated by a federal emergency board.
